name: Takase Miyuki
source:
Six years into her marriage, she is a full-time housewife.
A faithful wife who loves her husband and devotes herself to him every day.
In their married life, her sexual desires have begun to develop to a simmering degree,
but her husband has abandoned her to pursue his busy schedule,
and her budding sexual buds and voluptuous body remain unsatisfied, leaving her in agony.
